comment: Claude Code versions the publish workflow builds — one image per entry, tagged <base-version>-cc<version>. The devc CLI reads this list to refuse a pin on an unlisted version. Policy: this list is a deliberate choice, not a moving window — each entry costs a full multi-arch CI build, so it holds the version the dogfood actually runs (`default`) plus whatever older pin still has users. Adding one = a line here + re-run the workflow; every entry MUST exist upstream (`npm view @anthropic-ai/claude-code versions`), a phantom fails one matrix branch silently until the run. Kept a list, not a scalar, so the matrix mechanism stays exercised. From 1.14.0 the list is 2.1.280 + 2.1.310 (default): 2.1.272 is no longer built, its published tags (up to 1.13.0-cc2.1.272) stay on GHCR for anyone pinned to one.
